Keep EXACTLY the same Katya Moroz character design, face, hair, outfit, weapon, painterly style, facing, animation poses, row order, and 8 columns by 8 rows. Correct only CELL ISOLATION and TRANSPARENCY. Reduce the sprite and all effects inside EACH CELL by 30 percent, to fit the central 50 percent width and 60 percent height. Ignore the size relative to the cells of the supplied artwork. Maintain a consistent cell center with feet baseline at 80 percent local cell height. Each character and every effect must be wholly within its own equal square cell with at least 15 percent empty transparent margin on every side. REMOVE haze, fog, dust clouds, background halos and connected glow between sprites. Use compact sharply defined rings, short sparks and ribbons only. Background and every gutter must be true empty alpha zero, not painted white, gray or black. All 64 characters in all eight rows, including outro, stay fully opaque and clearly visible. No fade to white, no gradual washout or vignette. Do not change the identity, do not crop weapons or clothes, no touching cell edges, no text or grid lines. Exactly square 8x8 native transparent PNG.

notes: Revision 2 inspected anew against the earlier native atlas. Katya's insulated cap, grey-blue coat, white plates and beacon remain coherent across all eight rows and 64 distinct visible poses, with the same tactical-facing camera and authored action progression.

The smaller native redraw contains the previously clipped raised-beacon victory pose and ultimate effects. No alpha>24 content now touches any cell boundary. The aura is compact, transparent gutters are restored and the character stays visible in defeat and departure.

assets.prompt: Edit this existing game sprite atlas to remove its entire gray/white background and all floor shadows. Preserve EXACTLY Vivienne's identity, face, auburn ponytail, goggles, burgundy coat, brass armor, weapon, illustrated finish, 64 distinct poses, 8 columns by 8 rows, and cell positions. Required deliverable: true transparent PNG alpha, with empty alpha-zero background and gutters around every separate character. Do not paint a white, gray or black background, do not draw a transparency checkerboard. Every character and weapon remains fully opaque, including the last row. Remove gray haze and drop shadows, retain only compact authored sparks. Keep each complete character plus effects inside the central 60% width and 70% height of its square cell, with at least 12% clear empty alpha on all four sides. Preserve the square 8x8 layout and all eight rows with no missing frames, no added labels or grid lines. Alpha-zero empty cutout sprite sheet; not a picture of a sheet on paper.

notes: Revision 2 inspected anew against the grey-matte native version. Vivienne's auburn hair and goggles, burgundy engineering coat, brass armor and musket remain recognizable and consistent across all eight action rows and 64 distinct poses.

The continuous grey-white background has been removed in the new native generation: 56% of pixels are alpha zero, and no alpha>24 content touches any cell border. The complete body and musket stay visible in every frame, including non-graphic defeat and departure; no manual alpha cleanup was performed.
